BUG.stop: accepted behavior restored and regression evidence exists

FEATURE.stop: new behavior is accepted, implemented and verified

REFACTOR.stop: behavior is preserved and structural goal is verified

DOMAIN_DISCOVERY.stop: meaning, ownership and decision-critical rules are explicit

UI_UX.stop: interaction contract is implemented and verified

PERFORMANCE.stop: performance target is met with measured evidence

MIGRATION.stop: target state is verified and recovery window is resolved

RESEARCH.stop: decision-critical uncertainty is reduced enough to decide

INCIDENT.stop: service is contained or recovered and cause/follow-up is owned

DATA_REPAIR.stop: repair is auditable, verified and monitored

PRODUCTION_LEARNING.stop: expected-vs-observed result is classified and fed back

reroute_triggers: required evidence contradicts the current route
production behavior differs from the accepted contract
